    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Utils/log/libs label and changes src/util/fs_helpers.cpp (+25/-15).",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes AllocateFileRange so preallocating within existing file boundaries does not overwrite or truncate existing data on Windows and platforms using the zero-fill fallback. As described, the zero-fill fallback was zeroing out existing data when preallocating within current boundaries, violating basic file utility safety."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies ChainstateManager::LoadGenesisBlock in src/validation.cpp to manage block index recovery and prevent blk00000.dat corruption.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes silent block data destruction during -reindex on platforms without native posix_fallocate (like *BSD and OmniOS). Issue #33128 reported that recovering from a missing block index caused subsequent block data in blk00000.dat to be zeroed out, leaving nodes stuck at height 0; this PR preserves chain integrity by checking for an existing genesis block before writing."
    }
  ],
